name: Short Cut Roast Chicken Breast with Warm Feta-Tomato Sauce & Dressed Arugula

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 400°F. Wash and dry arugula, then set aside (skip this step if it came pre-washed).
Pat chicken dry with paper towels. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Place in one half of a large baking dish.
Wash and dry tomatoes. Add to the other half of the baking dish with the chicken. Nestle feta into the tomatoes, then drizzle everything with oil and season with spices.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 pint grape tomatoes
½ (8 oz) block feta cheese
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp Italian seasoning
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking dish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until chicken is cooked through and tomatoes start to burst, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven, then mash and combine tomatoes and feta with the back of a spoon or fork to create a sauce.
To serve, divide tomato-feta sauce, chicken, and arugula between plates. Drizzle arugula with dressing and enjoy!
